blog.title: Pink Cardigan Outfit with Wide-Leg Jeans
blog.intro: Soft knits, pink kicks and a little extra: this is Tommy Kate off duty. A textured pink cardigan layers over a white ribbed tank, with wide-leg denim, pink sneakers and a cream chain-strap bag keeping the outfit easy to wear. Those five pieces are the starting point. Her styled version adds pearls, a glitter claw clip, glossy pink beauty favorites and the everyday things she grabs before heading out. Lavender bedding, pink gingham and a vase of lilacs make the getting-ready scene feel personal. The accessories and surroundings are styling inspiration, separate from the five-piece shopping list.
